select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_num as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.building_user as use_unit, a.robot_source as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, a.address as place, (CASE WHEN a.robot_position = 155 THEN '2' WHEN a.robot_position = 156 THEN '1' WHEN a.robot_position = 399 THEN '3' end) as type, a.remarks as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code, '1' as edge,
from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.robot_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code where a.robot_type is not null

select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_code as patroldevice_code, a.robot_code as robot_num, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.building_user as use_unit, a.robot_source as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, a.address as place, (CASE WHEN a.drone_position = 674 THEN '13' end) as type, '' as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code, '1' as edge,
from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.drone_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code where a.drone_type is not null
